title: Finora Allowance Certificate
description: Issued by the (simulated) issuer when a user loads an allowance while online. The root of this file is the certificate; the revocation snapshot and the non-revocation proof are in $defs. Money is integer paise, timestamps are Unix seconds (UTC). No personal data.

DerSigBase64.description: Standard base64 (with padding) of a DER-encoded ECDSA P-256 signature.

deviceKeyHash.description: SHA-256 of the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo bytes of the payer's device public key. The payer sends the public key next to the certificate; the payee hashes it and compares.

ceilingPaise.description: Total spendable across the allowance. Default 500000 (Rs 5,000). Configurable.

perTxCapPaise.description: Maximum for one receipt. Default 100000 (Rs 1,000). Configurable. Must be <= ceilingPaise.

expiry.description: Unix seconds (UTC). A receipt whose ts is after this is invalid.

trustTier.description: Trust tier at issue time. Higher tier can mean higher caps. Informational for the payee.

issuerId.description: Id of the (simulated) issuer bank / Finora issuer whose key signed this.

issuerSignature.description: Issuer signature using the same rules as receipts: ECDSA P-256 over SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of all fields except issuerSignature.

epoch.description: Increases by 1 every time the revoked set changes. A device keeps the highest epoch it has seen and never goes back.

merkleRoot.description: Root of the sorted Merkle tree of revoked allowance ids (see README, 'Revocation snapshot and proofs').

issuedAt.description: Unix seconds (UTC). Payee apps use the age of the snapshot (now - issuedAt) to reduce the amount they accept: older snapshot, smaller limit.

signature.description: Issuer signature over SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of all fields except signature.

leafHash.description: The leaf value itself (already hashed, or a sentinel), as stored in the tree.

index.description: Zero-based position of this leaf in the sorted, padded leaf list.

path.description: Sibling hashes from the leaf level up to just below the root.

NonRevocationProof.description: Proves allowanceId is NOT in the revoked set of the snapshot with this epoch, by showing two neighbouring leaves with the allowance's leaf value between them.
